checked_contracts: close reads the actual optional helper/diagnostics/layout records, keeps pass/not_pass separate from review validity, and does not fabricate numerical outputs.
PASS requires all actual diagnostic checks, ten derive/build/write/layout/plot started/completed counters equal one, and tests/force/tangent/HP/solver/install counters equal zero.
Single expected tip_prepared PNG must be in original helper seals; one matching pixel media record and one inspection are required for PASS.

Layout field access agrees with native-circle-tip-layout-1.0: no baseline.right_medium assumption; historical old74/84 margin is distinct from candidate80/92 six-column strip. Geometry-only baseline and unsigned tip/global-distance limits are explicit.

Inherited gates/settings/options are only unexecuted stored instructions, and material/Lr80 and new92 top-uy scope are correctly described; no deformation/reaction/path completion or pressure qualification is inferred.

All seven front files are prechecked as exact BASE bytes before mutation; each is written as a new prefix plus the old raw bytes, then verified as exactly one old suffix. Git reads ordinary historical front text only.

Publisher restricts untracked files to new stage and tracked changes to seven fronts, rejects any default-source delta, dynamically inherits manifest entries without rescanning historical payload, and uses original producer seal plus stat for scientific/media suffixes.
Publisher ordinary commit/push and clean fast-forward restore target fixed origin and main. Every Git command disables automatic gc and maintenance; no force, retries or scientific calls.
Archive adds only the ordinary publication receipt plus manifest, validates restored metadata SHA and clean HEAD, and does not reopen scientific/media payloads.
limitations: This is a finite static review of ordinary postprocessing, not actual execution, image readability or future runtime success.
Closure and publication require verified original owned-process cleanup. A cleanup failure intentionally stops these scripts rather than claiming closure.
No whole-repository/historical-link scan or payload verification was performed.
